Made With Clean & Pure Ingredients
Paradise Sports & More products cater to a wide range of individuals, extending beyond the professional athlete to include everyday individuals seeking to enhance their quality of life.
Paradise Whey Protein, is a testament to purity and potency. Crafted for athletes and active individuals seeking the pinnacle of performance, our premium-grade whey protein offers unrivaled support for muscle growth, strength, and recovery. Made with the highest standards of quality and care, each scoop delivers clean, bioavailable protein to fuel your body's demands.
Formulated with athletes in mind, Paradise Whey Protein stands as a beacon of excellence in the sports and fitness world. Whether you're hitting the gym, the field, or the track, our whey protein provides the essential building blocks your body craves to thrive. With each sip, you're not just nourishing your muscles; you're empowering your journey towards greatness. Elevate your performance and embrace the power of Paradise Whey Protein.
At Paradise, our commitment to product excellence is unwavering. With over 30 years of experience, we have consistently sought out the purest and top-tier ingredients, absolutely free from fillers or binders. When you choose Paradise, you can trust that every product you receive represents the epitome of quality and purity.
We have further enhanced this with the addition of the plant derived enzyme Aminogen.  Research shows Aminogen to increase branched-chain amino acids by 250%, increase plasma amino acid levels over over 100%, increase glutamine levels by 90%, increase arginine by 80%, increase nitrogen retention by 32%, promote lean body mass, aid in muscle recovery, and may provide less gas, bloating and constipation.
